messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: page fired for prometheus_scrape_failure (alerts: prometheus/PrometheusScrapeErrorHigh)
incident-bot: Summary: scrape_proxies in eu-west-1 showing 75% scrape errors; missing node_exporter metrics for namespace 'prod-frontend'
Alex M: acked — I'm on it. grabbing latest alert graph.
Samira R: +1 ack. can we confirm customer impact before escalating? any dashboards broken? :eyes:
Mike S: looking at scrape-proxy logs, seeing lots of HTTP 429 from exporters. suspect rate-limited exporter or proxy overload.
Mike S: running quick rollout on scrape-proxy to pick up recent throttling patch.
Mike S: ```
kubectl -n monitoring rollout restart deploy/scrape-proxy-eu-west
kubectl -n monitoring get pods -l app=scrape-proxy -o wide
```
incident-bot: PagerDuty: 3/5 pages attempted, hitting PD rate-limit window. auto-escalation paused (suppression window 120s) to avoid alert storm.
Julia K: kafka topic metrics-ingest-backlog shows consumer lag increasing ~120k msgs. logs indicate backlog started ~09:02 UTC.
Alex M: If PD is rate-limited, let's do targeted manual PD escalations for high-importance customers only (Acme Corp, BetaPay). Samira, can you coordinate CS notification?
Samira R: I have Acme on slack + email. opening support ticket: https://redwood.support/tickets/RED-12345 — pinged CS with incident summary + ask to notify Acme dashboards may show missing CPU/memory metrics. :loudspeaker:
Mike S: scrape-proxy rollout shows pods restarting, health probes passing now. error-rate down to ~25% on one proxy node. continuing.
Julia K: scaled collectors HPA from 3 -> 6 to help drain backlog. command: ```kubectl -n ingest scale deployment/collector --replicas=6```
Alex M: check for missing metric fingerprints in prometheus: `rate(scrape_samples_post_metric_relabel[5m])` shows drop for node_exporter_prod_frontend.*
Mike S: found one exporter with misconfigured scrape_interval after config rollout. pushing quick patch to relabel config and reloading prom via config reload: `kubectl -n monitoring exec svc/prometheus -- kill -HUP 1`
incident-bot: manual page sent to oncall (Mike S) for the Acme impact group. PagerDuty note: "manual escalation for prod-frontend missing metrics"
Samira R: CS confirmed Acme dashboards blank for host metrics. Raising severity to Sev2 for customer-impacting missing metrics. CS will open support call if it persists >20m.
Alex M: temporary mitigation: enable backup scraping via eu-central region for prod-frontend namespace and enable kv-cache warm for exporters. I'm toggling route failover now.
Alex M: ```
# switch routing for prod-frontend to eu-central collector cluster
kubectl -n monitoring patch configmap/scrape-routing -p '{"data":{"prod-frontend":"eu-central"}}'
```
Julia K: backlog drain rate increased after scaling collectors and routing switch. consumer lag trending down, currently ~45k.
Mike S: node_exporter metrics for Acme returning on some hosts — partial recovery. continuing monitoring.
Samira R: CS pinged Acme support contact, left note and link to temporary dashboards (read-only) so they can validate. :white_check_mark:
Alex M: decision: keep auto-escalation suppressed for 20m to avoid PD storms; manual PD pages for impacted customers only. creating incident doc in /docs/incidents/RED-12345 to track timeline.
incident-bot: Note added: suppression reason set to "PD rate window"; suppression expires 20m from 1769004321.
Julia K: I'll keep running backlog checks and push if lag stops decreasing. if lag plateau we failover to cold storage consumer.
Mike S: handing off to night oncall @Mike S (staying onshift) — leaving run commands and checklist in thread. will escalate to infra if trend reverses.
Alex M: thanks team. if we hit new errors or CS reports fresh impact, re-open full PD escalation. otherwise we'll follow up with a short postmortem and config roll to prevent exporter throttles.
Samira R: noted, CS will follow up with customers and update ticket RED-12345. closing coordination thread for now — monitoring continues. :v:
incident-bot: Thread marked as active. last update at 1769004987
